derivative.change: The scalp's painted dark stubble blended into the atlas's own forehead tone (a bald crown); face, ears, body and hands unchanged. Same 2048 x 2048 size as the bronze atlas it replaces for this one asset.
derivative.why: John J. Glessner was bald on the crown with white hair at the sides (his 1897 plate, glessner_commercial_club_1910_presidents_plate); the side hair is grown as strands at runtime, so a painted dark crop would contradict the photograph.
